name: Tag
summary: A small, low-emphasis label for a category, keyword, or state.
lead: ONE custom element — <aha-tag> — defined once, imported unchanged by React and Vue. Shadow-DOM CSS, themed only by --aha-* tokens; tone is the `variant` attribute, and `closable` adds a dismiss affordance that emits a composed `close` event. Zero drift — the same element, not two look-alikes.
codeNote: Same element, same shadow-DOM CSS → identical render. React (< 19) consumes it via a thin ref wrapper; Vue binds the custom element natively. The primitive is defined once in @ahaslides-product/design.

props.name: close
props.desc: Composed event when the × is pressed

whenToUse.when: labelling content with a category/keyword, or showing a non-urgent state inline
a count or a status dot attached to another element
the chip should trigger an action — a Tag is a label, not a control

opinion.note: Keep tag text to one or two words, sentence case. Colour carries meaning — reserve success/warning/error for real states, not decoration.

snippets.label: HTML
snippets.note: The native form — a web component in an HTML file renders on open, no build step. The fast path for vibe-coding.

conformance.$about: Measured by qa.mjs against the RENDERED UI (getComputedStyle via headless CDP). Leaf = ONE shared element, single render.
